label: Monthly Transaction Trend
description: Transaction volume and count from successful transactions, grouped by month.
formula_plain_english: sum(revenue_amount) grouped by month(transaction_date) where transaction_status is completed
sql: SELECT STRFTIME(CAST({{transaction_date}} AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM({{revenue_amount}}) AS volume, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM {{fact}} WHERE {{transaction_status}} IN {{completed_values}} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
